FILTER (WHERE o.status = ?), ?)::text AS gross, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount - COALESCE(o.service_fee_minor, ?)) FILTER (WHERE o.status = ?), ?)::text AS refunds, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = ?)::text AS customers FROM orders.orders o JOIN catalog.events e ON e.id = o.event_id WHERE e.promoter_id = $1 AND COALESCE(o.currency, ?) = $2

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount - COALESCE(o.service_fee_minor, ?)) FILTER (WHERE o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL ?), ?)::text AS current_gross, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount - COALESCE(o.service_fee_minor, ?)) FILTER (WHERE o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL ? AND o.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL ?), ?)::text AS previous_gross FROM orders.orders o JOIN catalog.events e ON e.id = o.event_id WHERE e.promoter_id = $1 AND COALESCE(o.currency, ?) = $2 AND o.status = ?

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = ?)::text AS paid_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = ?)::text AS refunded_count FROM orders.orders o JOIN catalog.events e ON e.id = o.event_id WHERE e.promoter_id = $1 AND COALESCE(o.currency, ?) = $2 AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL ?

WITH days AS ( SELECT generate_series( DATE_TRUNC(?, NOW()) - INTERVAL ?, DATE_TRUNC(?, NOW()), ? ) AS day ) SELECT TO_CHAR(d.day, ?) AS day, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount - COALESCE(o.service_fee_minor, ?)), ?)::text AS gross, COUNT(o.id)::text AS orders_count FROM days d LEFT JOIN orders.orders o ON o.created_at >= d.day AND o.created_at < d.day + INTERVAL ? AND o.status = ? AND COALESCE(o.currency, ?) = $2 AND o.event_id IN (SELECT id FROM catalog.events WHERE promoter_id = $1) GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day
